#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <iomanip>

class InputReader {
public:
    std::istream& is;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int pos, size;

    InputReader(std::istream& is) : is(is), buf(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

private:
    int read() {
        if (size == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            is.read(buf.data(), buf.size());
            size = is.gcount();
            if (size <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buf[pos++]);
    }

    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class Main {
public:
    void run() {
        InputReader in(std::cin);
        std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(0);

        int mod = 998244353;
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        std::vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = in.nextInt();
            v[x] = 1;
        }
        std::vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if (p % 2 != 0) {
                ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
            }
            p /= 2;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
        }
        long long res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (res + static_cast<long long>(x) * x) % mod;
        }
        std::cout << res << std::endl;
    }

    std::vector<int> multiplyMod(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = std::max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));

        std::vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> aImaginary(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(a.size()); i++) {
            int x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);

        std::vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> bImaginary(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(b.size()); i++) {
            int x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

        std::vector<double> faReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> faImaginary(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> fbReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> fbImaginary(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

            double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
            double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
            double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

            faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

            fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }

        fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
        fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);
        std::vector<int> res(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long aa = llround(faReal[i]);
            long long bb = llround(fbReal[i]);
            long long cc = llround(faImaginary[i]);
            res[i] = static_cast<int>((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    void fft(std::vector<double>& a, std::vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
        int n = a.size();
        if (n == 0) return;
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reverse(i) >> shift;
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(a[i], a[j]);
                std::swap(b[i], b[j]);
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int halfLen = len >> 1;
            std::vector<double> cs(halfLen);
            std::vector<double> sn(halfLen);
            for (int i = 0; i < halfLen; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
                cs[i] = cos(angle);
                sn[i] = sin(angle);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < halfLen; j++) {
                    double wA = cs[j];
                    double wB = sn[j];
                    double uA = a[i + j];
                    double uB = b[i + j];
                    double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                    double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                    a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                    b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] /= n;
                b[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    Main mainInstance;
    mainInstance.run();
    return 0;
}
